# The Mindmaker

> Krish Raja helps senior leaders make and ship nervous AI decisions. Operator-advisor, not a consultant: no training, no decks, no demos, just decisions.

## Core offers

- [The Teardown](/teardown): $3,500 fixed, ten business days, one decision, under two hours of client time. The decision comes apart into the claims it rests on; each is checked against live evidence with a reliability tier; each consideration is classed External, Only you, or Nobody yet; four models cross-examine it with disagreements preserved rather than averaged. Ends in a one-page memo plus three claims under a 90-day watch, and includes a CTRL workspace and 30 days of Edge Pro. This is the entry rung and the gate for The Handover.
- [The Handover](/handover): $30,000 under 250 people, $50,000 for 250 to 5,000. Six weeks, and a completed Teardown is required first. Week 1 load and correct context, week 2 adversarial pre-mortem, week 3 the fork (rebuild GTM, pricing and positioning, or set the build order if already AI-native), week 4 the client drives, week 5 Krish does not attend, week 6 exit. Day 90 recheck included. Capped at six a year. Sold to the CEO, CRO or VP Product, never the CTO.
- Both rungs: 20% off in exchange for permission to write about the work, with the client approving how they are portrayed.
- [The AI-Fluent Executive (Cohort)](/cohort): $2,000 to $3,000 per seat, 4 weeks, quarterly. For senior leaders with a nervous AI decision to make. 10 to 15 seats per cohort, mostly async with weekly 90-minute live sessions. Diagnose, decompose, decide, deploy. Hosted on Maven at https://maven.com/mindmaker/the-ai-fluent-executive. The next cohort is sold out; Maven holds the waitlist.

## How I operate

- [The operating system behind Mindmaker](/operator): 14-agent fleet managing a 13-venture portfolio, memory architecture, cost optimization patterns. The operational foundation the commercial advice is built on.

## Try it

- [The Diagnosis Room](/start): An on-site guided experience. Mindy works through one nervous AI decision with you and ends in one of three honest exits: keep chatting, book a free 15-minute call, or download a co-branded one-page proposal. Free, no email required.
- [Mindmaker LIVE](/signal): Live model prices, weekly classified reads (WATCH / SKIP / CALL / TAKE), and the Nervous Decision Machine embedded in-page. Free, no email required.
- [Case studies](/case-studies): Anonymised client outcomes, filterable.
- 5 free Lightning Lessons hosted on Maven (https://maven.com/mindmaker): 45-minute sessions. Top-of-funnel free product.

## Positioning

Mindmaker is the anti-consultancy for leaders done being sold AI. The method is one thing sold two ways: build the brain that holds your business, anchored to the decisions you are actually making. Do it yourself with CTRL (https://ctrl.themindmaker.ai, free tier, Edge Pro at $49/month), or do it with Krish through The Teardown and then The Handover. Krish is an operator-advisor who runs a 14-agent AI business on his own P&L, so the commercial work comes out of production rather than out of a deck. No fractional executive roles. No ongoing retainers. No production IT work. Every engagement has a fixed scope and a finish line. Maven is the marketplace Mindmaker lists on; themindmaker.ai is the brand and operating centre.
